rationale: SWA window widened from last-5-of-6 (start_ep=1) to last-6-of-6 (start_ep=0). Full-training-window average on top of iter-35 substrate.
advice_for_others: Full-window SWA (start_ep=0) beats last-5-of-6 by +0.42pp. Even noisy epoch-0 weights help when uniformly averaged into a tightly trained run. Worth probing the schedule frontier next: epochs=8 with start_ep=0 (more data into avg) or EMA decay=0.99 for emphasis on later steps.
